mapping.draft_py:
# Wardens of the Cycle (FDN), a 3/4 creature.
# "Morbid -- At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, choose one --
#   * You gain 2 life.
#   * You draw a card and you lose 1 life."
# The compiled tree held "You gain 2 life." on the creature's cast carrier (orphaned, BACKLOG): this
# record replaces the whole tree. Morbid is an ability word (no rules meaning, CR 207.2c).
# Trigger: M21 Twinblade Assassins' verified B2a-twinblade-assassins, the same sentence up to the
#   effect: END_TURN of your turn, the intervening "if" DIED_THIS_TURN as the condition.
# Modes: Choose(count 1). Bullet 1 is the compiled B5c-bullet-gain-life atom, moved off the
#   carrier; bullet 2 is M20 Dread Presence's verified "You draw a card and you lose 1 life."
#   (DRAW then LOSE_LIFE, a Seq).
end_step = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.DIED_THIS_TURN),
    effect=Choose(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        options=(
            compiled[0].effect,
            Seq(
                steps=(
                    A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                    A(Verb.LOSE_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [end_step, SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE)]
